sources.title: Reed Flute Cave: The Largest and Most Impressive Cave in Guilin
sources.content:
Reed Flute Cave, Guilin - Complete Text Content

Overview
Reed Flute Cave is described as "a fascinating gallery that is full of natural limestone formations, formed by water erosion over millions of years." The cave features colorful illumination that enhances its natural beauty.

Formation & Features
Unlike typical caves formed by rock weathering, "Reed Flute Cave is formed by the uplift of underground lakes and water erosion." The stalactites and stalagmites display diverse shapes developed over millions of years. The cave is "illuminated by colorful lights, creating a magical and charming view," which differs from dimly-lit cave experiences and appeals to families with children.

Worth Visiting?
The attraction works best for first-time cave visitors. The colorful lighting "effectively alleviates the monotony of admiring rocks and people's fear of deep caves." However, those seeking less-developed, more authentic exploration might prefer Swallow Cave in Yangshuo instead.

Duration & Layout
Visitors typically spend approximately one hour exploring the cave. The cave extends about 240 meters, with the full U-shaped route covering roughly 500 meters. "The road is narrow and a little slippery due to the water drips from the top," potentially extending tour duration during crowded periods. No time limits are enforced.

Access & Transportation
Visitors can take "Bus No. 3" and exit at Ludiyan Station, followed by a 10-minute walk. Alternatively, taxis reach the entrance ticket office with a 4-minute uphill climb.

Visiting Strategy
Peak crowds typically arrive around 2 PM. Arriving at midday allows visitors to avoid congestion while enjoying the cave's natural cooling effect during summer months. Nearby Lujia Village offers refreshments including Guilin rice noodles.

Integration with Itinerary
Reed Flute Cave connects well with nearby attractions like Elephant Trunk Hill and Daxu Ancient Town, making it easily incorporable into multi-day Guilin trips.

sources.title: Reed Flute Cave Guilin: Facts, Opening Hours & Getting There
sources.content:
Reed Flute Cave Guilin - Complete Information

Location & Basic Facts
Reed Flute Cave is situated "3 Changhai Road, west side of Guilin City, 3 km from downtown" and approximately 5 kilometers northwest of the city center. It's recognized as "a famed cave to see karst landscape" and serves as "one landmark of Guilin city."

Opening Hours
- April to November: 7:30 AM - 6:00 PM
- December to March: 8:00 AM - 5:30 PM

Cave Specifications
The actual cave passage measures 240 meters in length, though the complete touring route extends approximately 500 meters. The cave features an extensive collection of natural formations including stalactites, stalagmites, stone pillars, and stone curtains illuminated by colored lighting.

Key Characteristics
The cave is described as having "more drip water constituted more stalactites, stalagmites, stone pillars" creating a developed interior space. Visitors experience "colored lights shining, like place oneself in fairyland." The formations resemble "ivory carvings" and "boxwood carving," earning the cave recognition as an "Art Palace of Nature."

Notable Named Sections
Interior areas include Virgin Forest, Crystal Palace, and Flower and Fruit Mountain.

Nearby Attractions
- Houshan Mountain (Guilin's highest peak)
- Peach Blossom River
- Ludi Park
- Feiluan Bridge (Fly Phoenix Bridge) - 62.4 meters long, constructed with green-black limestone

Visiting Tips
- Recommended duration: 1-2 hours
- Free Chinese guide service available inside the cave
- "The cave there are more steps and the ground is slippery, so please pay attention to safety and wearing sneakers"

Transportation Options
From Guilin South Train Station (6 km): Take public bus No. 3; operates 6:30 AM - 9:50 PM; departs every 10 minutes; costs 1 RMB per person
From Downtown (5 km): Public buses No. 3, 213, or 4A Special Line available
From Liangjiang International Airport (25 km): Taxi via Longyin Road and Peach Blossom Road

sources.title: Travel Tips and Must-See Highlights for Reed Flute Cave in Guilin (2026)
sources.content:
Travel Tips and Must-See Highlights for Reed Flute Cave in Guilin (2026)

Reed Flute Cave is located 5 km northwest of downtown Guilin and has been a major tourist attraction for over 1200 years. The cave opens at 8:00 a.m. and closes at 5:30 p.m.

Inside you'll see limestone formations that twist and turn into amazing shapes, with colorful lights bringing these natural wonders to life. Famous rock formations include Flower and Fruit Mountain, the Lion Looking at Curtain, and the Virgin Forest.

Best Time to Visit: April, May, September, or October offer nice weather and fewer crowds. Inside the cave, it stays warm in the winter and cool in the summer, maintaining a consistent temperature of around 20 degrees Celsius (68 degrees Fahrenheit) throughout the year.

Getting There: A taxi is the fastest and most comfortable way, and the ride takes about 20 minutes from downtown Guilin. Alternatively, you can take Tourist Bus Line 1, which goes straight to Reed Flute Cave and runs from early morning until late evening.

Practical Tips: In the cave there are many steps and the ground is slippery, so wearing sneakers is recommended. Plan to spend between 1 and 2 hours exploring.

2026 Special Event: During the 2026 Spring Festival, Reed Flute Cave presents a "New Year Sets Sail - Success Arrives Swiftly" celebration, featuring Year of the Horse-themed lanterns alongside stalactites.

sources.title: Reed Flute Cave in Guilin, China - VisitGuilin.org
sources.content:
Reed Flute Cave in Guilin

Reed Flute Cave is located five kilometers northwest of downtown Guilin and is marked on almost all travel itineraries. The cave got its name from the verdant reeds growing outside it, with which people make flutes.

Inside this water-eroded cave is a spectacular world of various stalactites, stone pillars and rock formations created by carbonate deposition, illuminated by colored lighting. Tourists enter the cave and take a U-shaped sight-seeing route to see different spots, whereupon they exit from another cave quite near the entrance one, with one trip lasting about one hour.

Typically, it would take an hour to fully appreciate the beauty of Reed Flute Cave. However, visitors are recommended to spare at least 1-2 hours to truly enjoy a visit.

Some 70 inscriptions on the cave wall are said to be travelogues and poems derived from the Tang Dynasty (618-907), which made the cave a popular tourist site at that time.

Practical Tips:
- Sports shoes are recommended as there will be dripping water and the ground will be wet in the cave.
- You may take photos inside the cave, but make sure not to use flash.
- April to October is especially great for a Reed Flute Cave tour.
- Inside it stays warm in the winter and cool in the summer, maintaining a consistent temperature of around 20 degrees Celsius.

Ticket Price: 90 RMB for adults, 45 RMB for children, free entry for children under 120 centimeters.
Hours: 08:00-17:30 (Dec.-Mar.); 07:30-18:00 (Apr.-Nov.)
Address: #1 Ludi Road, Xiufeng District, Guilin, Guangxi Province
Transportation: buses 3, 58, 4A, and 13 all go to the cave.

sources.title: Guilin Reed Flute Cave: Highlights, Travel Tips & Best Time to Visit
sources.content:
Guilin Reed Flute Cave: Highlights, Travel Tips & Best Time to Visit

Reed Flute Cave has been a major tourist attraction for over 1,200 years. Located 5 km northwest of downtown Guilin, it is one of the most famous caves in the region.

The cave maintains a consistent temperature of around 20 degrees Celsius year-round, making it comfortable to visit in any season. Inside, you'll find limestone formations illuminated by colorful lights, including famous spots like the Crystal Palace, Flower and Fruit Mountain, and the Virgin Forest.

Best months to visit are April, May, September, and October for pleasant weather and fewer crowds. The cave is open 08:00-17:30 in winter and 07:30-18:00 in summer.

Remember to bring an electric torch and wear sports shoes, as the illuminations may be turned off as the crowds move on and the path may be slippery.

sources.title: 芦笛岩_百度百科
sources.content:
芦笛岩百度百科

基本信息
芦笛岩位于桂林市西北桃花江畔，距市中心5公里，是国家首批AAAA级景区，也是漓江风景名胜区的重要组成部分。

地理与规模
"洞深240米，游程500米"，洞内最宽处93米，最高18米。这处岩溶景观约70万年前因地下水溶蚀而形成。

主要景观
洞内包含狮岭朝霞、水晶宫、盘龙宝塔、原始森林等20多处景点，以及密集的钟乳石、石笋、石柱、石幔和石花等自然形成的地质奇观。

文化价值
"从唐代起，历代都有游人踪迹，现洞内存历代壁画77则"，其中最早的壁书可追溯至唐代贞元年间。

旅游信息
- 门票：90元
- 开放时间：09:00-17:00
- 最佳游览季节：四季皆宜，4-10月最佳

历史发展
遗存的古代题名和题诗表明该洞为历史悠久的游览胜地。1959年经村民举报勘测，1962年正式向公众开放。

特色评价
被誉为"大自然的艺术之宫"，因其"水滴石长"的钟乳石生长特征而著称，已接待过众多国家领导人和外国政要，被称为"国宾洞"。

sources.title: 桂林芦笛岩游玩攻略 - 携程攻略
sources.content:
芦笛岩游玩攻略（携程）

成人票90元，半价票45元（适用于6周岁18周岁学生、全日制大学本科及以下学历学生、65周岁以上老人等）。

开放时间：08:00-17:30（7月1日-12月31日）；09:00-17:00（1月1日-6月30日）。

洞内游览全程约500米，游玩时间约1-3小时。洞内有免费中文导游讲解，讲解员会详细介绍各个景点。

水晶宫是芦笛岩最宽阔、最美的部分，位于古地下湖深处，钟乳石四悬，如盏盏宫灯，辉煌高贵。其他景观如"圆顶蚊帐""高峡飞瀑""盘龙宝塔""原始森林"等，景景相连，移步换景。

注意事项：洞内温度较低（17-19℃），建议携带薄外套；洞内地面湿滑，建议穿着舒适的旅游鞋。

交通方式：可乘坐市内3路、213路公交车直达景区。
